title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer regional failover ordering and backoff
author: Asha Patel
description:
Context: Following an incident on 2026-02-18 we observed the SLO enforcer's regional failover path could trigger concurrent backoff timers and out-of-order circuit-breaker state transitions during bursty regional latency spikes. This caused transient over-shedding in secondary regions and delayed recovery, impacting a subset of Dedicated clusters. This PR implements a focused hotfix to stabilize ordering and introduce guardrails for backoff jitter and quorum checks.

What this changes: - Ensure single-threaded state transitions for region-level enforcers using a lightweight in-process ordering token. - Add idempotent apply_state transition with last-applied-version checks to avoid regressions from reordered events. - Introduce bounded backoff jitter (min/max) and ensure backoff timers are canceled on explicit successful health probes. - Add a quorum-based regional-OK check before clearing circuit-breaker flags to avoid flapping when a minority of proxies recover. - Add metrics and tracing spans for ordering-token acquisition, canceled timers, and quorum-evaluation decisions.

Why: These changes target the root cause (race between async health events and backoff timers) and prevent pathological load-shedding during recovery windows while keeping failover fast.

Testing and rollout plan: - Unit tests for apply_state idempotency and ordering token. - Integration canary in us-west-2 with synthetic traffic profile mirroring the incident; metrics validated in Redwood Console. - Gradual rollout to other regions with a 5-minute canary window and kill-switch feature flag.

Checklist: [x] reproduce locally via incident harness [x] add unit + integration tests [x] metrics/tracing added [x] staged canary verified in us-west-2 [x] added rollback kill-switch

References: Linear ENG-4501, ENG-4520 and incident postmortem: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4501/regional-failover-thrashing-2026-02-18

release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize regional failover ordering and backoff for SLO enforcer; reduces unnecessary load-shedding during recovery windows and improves recovery stability.
notes_for_ops: Rollout: feature flag hotfix.slo.enforcer.regional_ordering=true. Canary in us-west-2 for 30 minutes, monitor enforcer.backoff_canceled and enforcer.quorum_pass_rate. Rollback: flip flag to false and purge ordering token cache via admin endpoint.
testing_summary: Unit tests: added 14 new tests covering ordering + quorum + backoff; Integration: canary load profile passed with 99.9% SLO adherence in us-west-2 during 30m run; CI: all checks passed after rerun.
additional_context: Related PRs: pr-102345-hotfix-slo-enforcer-backoff-ordering-race.json (previous attempt addressed timer cancellation but not quorum edgecases). This PR is intentionally minimal and guarded by a feature flag to reduce blast radius.
